DK27.0 is a specific medical diagnosis code representing acute gastroduodenal ulcer with hemorrhage ("akut gastroduodenalt ulcus med blødning"). In the context of the Danish healthcare system's quality monitoring for [[atrieflimren]], this code plays a critical role in tracking patient safety and treatment complications. Specifically, it is utilized as one of the diagnostic identifiers to calculate the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among patients being treated for atrial fibrillation [^src1] [^src3].

The tracking of severe bleeding is a key quality indicator in the national clinical databases managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut). To accurately capture the incidence of severe bleeding, the registries employ a broad spectrum of ICD-10 diagnosis codes. DK27.0 falls under the category of gastrointestinal bleeding codes, which range from DK25.0 to DK29.8A and DK92.0 to DK92.2 [^src1]. Other categories tracked alongside it include intracranial bleeding (e.g., [[di60|DI60]]–[[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary/respiratory tract bleeding (e.g., [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. The consistent inclusion of DK27.0 across the 2023, 2024, and 2025 annual reports for atrial fibrillation in Denmark underscores its stable definition and ongoing importance in evaluating the safety of antithrombotic and anticoagulant therapies in this patient population [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

## Claims
- **Diagnostic:** For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
